programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #9
programme.desc: 轉移失敗而在雷傑王國被捕的緋紅受到銀器公主絲塔莉亞審問。為脫離險境,緋紅使出渾身解數以高超演技進行交涉。但絲塔莉亞卓越的敏銳感受力,看穿了她的危險本質。在千鈞一髮之際醒來的拉格納化解了眼前危機,但絲塔莉亞的樣子卻在見到拉格納後變得不對勁。.(n)

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #10
programme.desc: 銀裝兵團為了從翼之血族的包圍中逃脫而召開了作戰會議。在被拉格納說服後,絲塔莉亞決定讓他及緋紅加入銀裝兵團的主力部隊,並重新為迎戰奧魯特佐拉及達拉迪克多拉進行準備。另一方面,在王都被逼入絕境的奧偍瑪蒂亞,仍未從對拉格納的恐懼中振作起來。.(n)

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #11
programme.desc: 拉格納為了將銀氣注入武器,和銀裝兵團團員們進行了一場交流。而緋紅則為了讓眾人從翼之血族的包圍中逃脫,著手協助完成轉移魔法陣。正當每個人各自都在逐步為戰鬥做準備時,史萊姆踩到了赫澤拉與克蕾雅的地雷,一場出人意料之外的悲劇正等著他。.(n)

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #0
programme.desc: 在建造於小行星上的前線弗爾克范格,凡納迪斯機構的實驗室中,進行著魔靈高達的運作實驗。眼見魔靈高達無法達成評議會要求的條件,測試駕駛員艾爾諾拉・薩瑪雅顯得十分焦慮。――那天正是她女兒迎來四歲生日的日子。.(n)

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #1
programme.desc: 宇宙產業大公司貝納里特集團經營著阿斯提卡西亞高等專門學園。來自水星的轉學生蘇萊塔・墨丘利為即將展開的校園新生活雀躍不已。然而就在快到達學校時,她發現有一道身影漂浮於宇宙中。.(n)

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #2
programme.desc: 蘇萊塔與古爾的決鬥後獲勝。然而她的機動戰士風靈卻涉嫌使用被禁止的魔女技術GUND FORMAT。在此同時,米奧莉奈因為父親戴林格而面對退學危機。.(n)

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #10
programme.desc: 拉妮亞被擊敗,「阿蒙」之力落入阿西爾手中!他運用「特權魔法」及兩股強大的力量,阻擋在紅戰士面前。阿西爾揮舞著支配之力,試圖獨自實現「夢想」。他所追求的「夢想」究竟是?(n)

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #11
programme.desc: 阿西爾化身為沙塵暴,力量失控了!紅戰士與四人的羈絆合而為一,使「極限羈絆凱撒」的力量發揮至100%後,與眾人一同追擊阿西爾。面對逐漸逼近太陽之森的阿西爾,紅戰士究竟能不能阻止他?(n)

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #12
programme.desc: 為了對抗阿布達比和維丹這兩名強大的魔王族,燈悟奮不顧身地使出最終手段。他絆裝變身的模樣,並非熾熱友情的戰士「羈絆紅」,而是有著深沉執著的戰士「羈絆黑」。焚盡萬物的漆黑業火在戰場上翻騰!究竟他們戰鬥的結局會是如何?(n)

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #8
programme.desc: 想起與兔耳山相遇後快樂的時光,在他成為頭領後變了樣的集團,以及自己做過的一切,十龜難掩內心迷惘。感覺到十龜的變化,櫻首次在打架中產生想要了解對方的念頭。兩人以拳對話,帶著笑容戰鬥的模樣震撼全場,而劃破場內沉默的是十龜的一句「到此結束吧」。.(n)

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #9
programme.desc: 兔耳山深信只要打贏梅宮,獲得防風鈴與自由,就能變得比誰都要「快樂」。他乘勢持續攻擊梅宮,卻沒有對他造成絲毫傷害。無法理解梅宮所說的「你的拳頭太弱,因為沒有背負任何東西」的兔耳山,在受到梅宮全力一擊後,浮現腦海的是開懷大笑的獅子頭連成員們。.(n)

programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The World Heritage Sites in Japan

programme.title: 絕地生還 - 星級澳洲篇
programme.desc: Will the heroes rise? Will the snakes take over? All will be revealed but there’s no doubt this season will see some of the biggest blindsides and moves in Australian Survivor history.Returning to the beautiful and rugged Savusavu in Fiji, these All Stars will have to fight harder than ever before to battle it out to the end. In the final Tribal Council, the Jury will make the decision on who will win and who is deserving of the ultimate prize of $500,000.Hosted by Jonathan LaPaglia, Australian Survivor: All Stars will prove to be the biggest season we’ve seen so far.

programme.title: America's Got Talent
programme.desc: A talent competition where an array of performers -- from singers and dancers, to comedians and novelty acts -- vie for a $1 million cash prize.

programme.title: Plastic People: The Hidden Crisis of Microplastics
programme.desc: Scientists investigate the threat of microplastics in human bodies. Journalist visits labs and undergoes testing to find plastic in home, food and body.

programme.title: Klincus
programme.desc: Klincus befriends the tiny inhabitants of the treetop village Frondosa in Bosco Grande forest. He protects them from industrialist Graylock's deforestation plans, discovering his abilities while learning life lessons.

programme.title: Dinomite & Lucy
programme.desc: Back in the day, dinosaurs ruled the world. Dinomite is one of them and Lucy is his human friend! For this odd couple – Dinomite‘s head buzzing with ideas and Lucy full of boundless cave girl energy – every day brings new adventure and excitement.

programme.title: Dinomite & Lucy

programme.title: Miniheroes of the Forest
programme.desc: Any time is a good time to play: Gaston the Bear, Juliette the Owl, Jade the Fox and Gabin the Rabbit can't wait to find out what super adventures the forest has in store for them. To accomplish their incredible missions, the MiniHeroes need little their Cloak, Mask and Mega Powers! And after all, the greatest adventure of all is friendship.

programme.title: Angry Birds
programme.desc: As the result of a simple accident, Angry Birds Red, Chuck and Bomb are cast out of their home and into a strange, unfamiliar world where nothing makes sense - the human world.

programme.title: 加拿大冒險之旅
programme.desc: On Griff’s Canadian Adventure, Welsh comedian and travel enthusiast Griff Rhys Jones embarks on a journey across the second largest Country on the planet; Canada. Through mountains, prairies, ice and forest, travelling from East to West, Griff will explore how it’s history has shaped the Canada of today and uncover what makes each province so tantalizingly unique, yet distinctly Canadian. From the rugged Atlantic Coast of Newfoundland to Vancouver in the Pacific Northwest, each episode will see Griff undergo a challenge to truly experience each province, with a little help from locals and experts he meets along the way.

programme.title: 高度設防: 鐵窗之內
programme.desc: Five hardened criminals, one unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary.Singapore’s Changi Prison is a concrete purgatory, spartan to the extreme. There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells. A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole. Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security. Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most recalcitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore’s reoffending rates are among the lowest globally. Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within two years after their release.For the first time ever, five inmates, incarcerated multiple times and at least once at maximum security, agree to reveal their full identities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Cha.(n)

programme.title: 山旮旯小島
programme.desc: Tiny Islands explores a set of magical island-hopping adventures across Britain’s greatest hidden treasures. Celebrating the secret places, extraordinary people, surprising jobs and gripping local history that make our ‘tiny islands’ wonders of the world...There are 6,289 islands scattered across our waters, but only 803 are large enough to be drawn on a map. Yet what they lack in size they make up for in character, culture and community.With locals and people with specialist knowledge as our guides, we will explore these little worlds, looking at the history, the traditions, the legends and folklore, the lives of those who live there, and the wildlife. We will visit ancient ruins and modern houses. Monks and artists will jostle for our attention alongside farmers and fishermen.These rugged and breath-taking landscapes are unique, yet all with a story to tell about Britain. These are our Tiny Islands....(n)

programme.title: 高度設防: 鐵窗之內
programme.desc: Five hardened criminals, one unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary.Singapore’s Changi Prison is a concrete purgatory, spartan to the extreme. There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells. A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole. Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security. Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most recalcitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore’s reoffending rates are among the lowest globally. Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within two years after their release.For the first time ever, five inmates, incarcerated multiple times and at least once at maximum security, agree to reveal their full identities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Cha.(n)

programme.title: 山旮旯小島
programme.desc: Tiny Islands explores a set of magical island-hopping adventures across Britain’s greatest hidden treasures. Celebrating the secret places, extraordinary people, surprising jobs and gripping local history that make our ‘tiny islands’ wonders of the world...There are 6,289 islands scattered across our waters, but only 803 are large enough to be drawn on a map. Yet what they lack in size they make up for in character, culture and community.With locals and people with specialist knowledge as our guides, we will explore these little worlds, looking at the history, the traditions, the legends and folklore, the lives of those who live there, and the wildlife. We will visit ancient ruins and modern houses. Monks and artists will jostle for our attention alongside farmers and fishermen.These rugged and breath-taking landscapes are unique, yet all with a story to tell about Britain. These are our Tiny Islands....(n)

programme.title: 辣王傳
programme.desc: 印尼華僑的女兒－娟姐與有越南血統的 Nana 帶 Dee 在港食越南及印尼菜。首先，三人去食香港少見的越北菜，不論菜色的賣相或是味道都同香港常見的越南菜不同。越南菜多以辣椒提味，辣王 Dee 又喜不喜歡呢？ViuTV 辣后娟姐自小在家培訓食辣，想當然印尼人有幾食得辣。三人食傳統印尼菜，最後 Dee 更挑戰舖滿辣椒的炸雞.

programme.title: 癮營人

programme.title: STEM By You
programme.desc: 你每天有算著自己吃了多少東西嗎？每款食物都有相應的熱量，千卡路里正是這些熱量的單位。而究竟熱量是如何被計算出來的？成年人每天需要多少千卡路里？0卡食物又真的存在嗎.

programme.title: 飛黃騰達

programme.title: 細事都被你看透
programme.desc: 「網上起人底！係彰顯正義定陷人於不義？」「關愛座冇人座，你坐咗係咪錯？」網上熱話無奇不有，而且浮現了奇異現象；事件即使雞毛蒜皮，談論總是樂此不疲，題材趣怪貼地，回應自然舖天蓋地，隨時比大新聞更轟動。全新訪談節目，將會透過不同藝人、專家及講者，從多角度分析每日最hit話題，娛樂民生，衣食住行，無所不談。話題看似事不關己，實際影響其實殺到埋身！未雨绸缪，不再食花生，捍衛立場，舌劍唇槍，一於「小題大做」！濕碎嘢，認真傾，集大成，看世情.

programme.title: 協商的技術

programme.title: 無痕旅遊模式
programme.desc: 旅行是消費、消遣、同時亦是「消耗」。旅遊是環境殺手之一，「報復性旅遊」真正報復的，就是我們的地球！是次節目《無痕旅遊模式》秉持一份負責任的旅行態度，強調旅行者的每個決定都要盡力減低對環境負擔，務求以對地球不留痕跡的方式出遊。將「永續旅遊」以充滿驚喜、新奇及刺激的方式實踐！透過旅行，打開與大自然對話；召喚出保衛地球之靈魂；引導眾生回歸旅遊正途，一切──由《無痕旅遊模式》開始.

programme.desc: 旅行是消費、消遣、同時亦是「消耗」。旅遊是環境殺手之一，「報復性旅遊」真正報復的，就是我們的地球！是次節目《無痕旅遊模式》秉持一份負責任的旅行態度，強調旅行者的每個決定都要盡力減低對環境負擔，務求以對地球不留痕跡的方式出遊。將「永續旅遊」以充滿驚喜、新奇及刺激的方式實踐！透過旅行，打開與大自然對話；召喚出保衛地球之靈魂；引導眾生回歸旅遊正途，一切──由《無痕旅遊模式》開始.

programme.title: 晚吹 - 男人亂講嘢
programme.desc: 世界覺醒（WOKE）了，每天都變得更像彩虹更有活力！從來以為自己是世界中心的男人卻呆站原地，眼光光看著日換星移宇宙萬變，看似固步自封但其實是有心無力！為舒緩廣大香港男士因為社會價值急速變化產生的焦慮和不安，三字頭的193（郭嘉駿）、四字頭的阿Thor（駱振偉）、以及五字頭的灘叔（鄒凱光）每星期都會圍爐亂講一通︰講男人求偶、男人私怨、男人包袱、男人浪漫、男人衰嘢、男人保健、男人蠢事——女觀眾或會恥笑，但男觀眾一定會感動大笑！就此召喚迷途的新時代男性，同《男人亂講嘢》一齊尋找當下世界觀，刷新固有價值觀，重塑男人三十、四十、五十路的人生觀！今次唔係要話人知男人曾經有幾威，而係要探討宜家男人有幾閉翳.

programme.title: 細事都被你看透
programme.desc: 「網上起人底！係彰顯正義定陷人於不義？」「關愛座冇人座，你坐咗係咪錯？」網上熱話無奇不有，而且浮現了奇異現象；事件即使雞毛蒜皮，談論總是樂此不疲，題材趣怪貼地，回應自然舖天蓋地，隨時比大新聞更轟動。全新訪談節目，將會透過不同藝人、專家及講者，從多角度分析每日最hit話題，娛樂民生，衣食住行，無所不談。話題看似事不關己，實際影響其實殺到埋身！未雨绸缪，不再食花生，捍衛立場，舌劍唇槍，一於「小題大做」！濕碎嘢，認真傾，集大成，看世情.(n)

programme.title: 德國寶入伙專家呈獻: 鬼宮
programme.desc: 汝里意識到風山就是餓鬼，她被強行帶走並藏了起來。姜哲前往盲廳尋找她，餓鬼向他表明了自己的真實身份。姜哲正打算把一個邪惡的貴族交給畢比當獵物，卻被汝里的突然介入阻止了。王想知道風山背後的真兇，於是盤問了大妃.(n)

programme.title: 無痕旅遊模式
programme.desc: 旅行是消費、消遣、同時亦是「消耗」。旅遊是環境殺手之一，「報復性旅遊」真正報復的，就是我們的地球！是次節目《無痕旅遊模式》秉持一份負責任的旅行態度，強調旅行者的每個決定都要盡力減低對環境負擔，務求以對地球不留痕跡的方式出遊。將「永續旅遊」以充滿驚喜、新奇及刺激的方式實踐！透過旅行，打開與大自然對話；召喚出保衛地球之靈魂；引導眾生回歸旅遊正途，一切──由《無痕旅遊模式》開始.(n)

programme.title: 晚吹 - Chat KP
programme.desc: 生活總會遇上大小煩惱及奇怪遭遇，無論來自事業、家庭、愛情、朋友、自身，無論發生在工作環境、家居、街道、商場、食肆 … … 總有林林總總，各式奇式的事情讓你困擾尷尬、不吐不快、睇唔過眼、不便開口、想搵人傾吓笑吓，或者尋求建議指引…遇到疑難，不懂抉擇；奇趣遭遇，想開心share，歡迎留言及來信本節目，見過風浪、閱人無數，走遍劇場及大小螢幕的都會女主持彭秀慧（KP），會聯同現場觀眾或與知名嘉賓互動，以開信形式，甚至即場phone in，同大家一齊拆解研究，為大家提供建議、指引或心靈輔導，助你一解心扉，一齊一笑解千愁.(n)

programme.desc: 香港中文大學校長，李嘉誠醫學講座教授及香港科學院院長。國際液體活檢領域全球奠基者及領導者，被譽為「無創產前檢測之父」。香港中文大學，是香港歷史最悠久的高等學院之一，也是香港唯一實行書院制大學。在國際擁有重要學術影響力及競爭力，以「結合傳統與現代，融會中國與西方」為使命.(n)

programme.title: STEM By You
programme.desc: 日常隨處可見的液體，包括是人類生活必需的水，你知道它們背後還有甚麼特質嗎？已經被混合了的液體，又沒有再被分開的可能性？液體的密度、蒸發速度，又有怎樣的不同.(n)

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 地方創生是除了大城市以外的創新經濟命脈，尤其是偏遠的山旮旯更是如此需要，拯救隊的Dixon與王鋒首先來到台北這大都會中的文化園區先拜訪了用拉拉山上五月桃製作的產品，之後跟著李沿儒 老師來到了拉拉山的三光部落，理事長阿偉帶著拯救隊們介紹了部落與種植地的的變遷與辛苦.(n)

programme.title: 癮營人
programme.sub-title: 容貌焦慮 VS 心靈派
programme.desc: Emily曾患玫瑰痤瘡，自此產生陰影，出現容貌焦慮，極度在意臉上的所謂「粒粒」，無論潔面或飲食，都訂下若干指引，並嚴格遵從；Shaliman也在意外貌，但曾經因為工作壓力大，令皮膚欠佳，自此，她明白豁達、自信、輕鬆自在，才是美麗的王道，於是追求心靈恬靜。Shaliman明白Emily的痛苦，當一齊清潔廚房時，Emily講到很怕污水沾到自己的臉，Shaliman因她的心結而流淚.(n)

programme.title: 巴絲Let’s go歐
programme.sub-title: 首次兄妹遊，193同3妹葡國之旅出發
programme.desc: 從未試過兩兄妹去旅行193＠ERROR同細妹郭嘉盈（Michelle），踏上葡萄牙之旅，行程充滿未知數！第一站竟然就去193最驚嘅地方，但Michelle似乎就樂在其中；第二站唔係葡萄牙必到靚景，而係帶佢哋去學化妝，而化妝嘅對象仲要係..(n)

programme.title: 穿越阿拉伯
programme.desc: 來到沙漠城市，點可以冇駱駝?今集首先會帶大家去睇睇現代沙漠城市的賽駱駝比賽;Brian再一次潛入水底，體驗同各種魚一齊水底漫步;最後同大家參觀未來博物館，睇下各種與未來有關的事物.(n)

programme.title: 也文也武同學仔
programme.sub-title: 世界龍岡學校劉皇發中學
programme.desc: 現在香港的同學仔真是能文能武，就好像位於大角咀的世界龍岡學校劉皇發中學，這裡的同學仔竟然可以利用茶包去製作過濾用的濾芯，還有劍擊隊的同學在公開比賽中穫得好好的成績.(n)

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.(n)

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.(n)

programme.title: 淘寶呈獻: 淘一個家
programme.desc: 新生命即將降臨！新手父母手忙腳亂！雜物間搖身一變木色系嬰兒房.(n)

programme.title: Gen Z觀察學
programme.sub-title: GenZ Ocamp 最終回！（運動組及創意組
programme.desc: 嚟到GenZ O Camp嘅最終回！今集強尼集齊四位新GenZ：湯雞、Kei、Cherry同阿朗！一如既往，四位初見面唔透露身份，一齊憑住第一印象去整陶瓷俾彼此！之後仲邀來註冊組織心理學家Mills Wong同四位玩個VR性格測驗！經歷咁豐富嘅環節之後，終於要揭撓究竟佢哋邊個係來自運動組，邊個來自創意組！.(n)

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 愛滋病，一個令人聞風喪膽的病，現今是否仍是一個「不治之症」？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來素海霖一起請教醫生！愛滋病的各種謬誤，讓醫生逐一破解.(n)

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 不同年代也會誕生著不同的流行曲。開心時，你會聽著某些流行曲；悲傷時，你會聽著某些流行曲，這些流行曲總伴隨著你我長成。《Chill Club》透過主持駱振偉，聯同每集不同嘉賓，唱出不同年代的流行曲，重塑各個觀眾對那些流行曲的情懷及回憶。而且，每一集都會有「新歌推介」，令觀眾也可得知現時最新的流行曲.(n)

programme.title: 蠟筆小新
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事.(n)

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.

programme.title: 私人銀行家
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突.

programme.title: 孤獨死又怎樣
programme.desc: 山口鳴海（綾瀨遙飾），過著未婚、無子、獨居的自在人生。然而，憧憬已久、事業有成的伯母，卻意外孤獨死去—這場衝擊讓鳴海開始焦慮，急忙投入婚活，卻屢屢碰壁。就在這時，年下同事那須田優彌（佐野勇斗飾）毫不留情地說道：「覺得結婚就能安心，這可是昭和時代的想法吧？」被這句話點醒後，鳴海毅然放棄婚活，轉而開始思考「終活」，試圖為自己的人生畫出更好的結尾。這是一部描繪三十代後半單身女性，在世俗眼光中受傷、在與他人比較中動搖，又在感激那些—直陪伴在身邊的人之中，掙扎著、努力著，為了「好好死去」，也為了「好好活著」而—步步摸索前行的故事.

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.desc: 山口鳴海（綾瀨遙飾），過著未婚、無子、獨居的自在人生。然而，憧憬已久、事業有成的伯母，卻意外孤獨死去—這場衝擊讓鳴海開始焦慮，急忙投入婚活，卻屢屢碰壁。就在這時，年下同事那須田優彌（佐野勇斗飾）毫不留情地說道：「覺得結婚就能安心，這可是昭和時代的想法吧？」被這句話點醒後，鳴海毅然放棄婚活，轉而開始思考「終活」，試圖為自己的人生畫出更好的結尾。這是一部描繪三十代後半單身女性，在世俗眼光中受傷、在與他人比較中動搖，又在感激那些—直陪伴在身邊的人之中，掙扎著、努力著，為了「好好死去」，也為了「好好活著」而—步步摸索前行的故事.

programme.title: 大奧
programme.desc: 在江戶時代中期，經濟持續惡化，日本國民每天都被迫過著樸素、節儉、勤勞的生活。百姓們等待著一位能夠改善經濟現狀、使國家和百姓富裕起來的將軍出現。在這樣的背景下，五十宮倫子被迫與德川幕府第十代幕府將軍德川家治進行政治婚姻，從京都前往位於江戶城中心區的大奧，那裡有近千名侍奉將軍的女性。為了贏得將軍的寵愛，此刻，女人們的鬥爭即將拉開帷幕。另一方面，有人正在策劃陰謀，企圖將大奧與江戶幕府拉入混亂的旋渦當中.

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 初次，為了愛
programme.desc: 43歲的單親媽媽帶著23歲頂尖醫科生女兒搬到了鄉下小鎮，生活由此發生了翻天覆地的變化。兩人渴望平靜，卻發現自己被古怪卻又熱心的村民包圍，其中包括喪偶的藥劑師。母女之間的緊張關係也逐漸升溫，迎來人生第二幕.

programme.title: 金子般我的明星
programme.desc: 劇情講述韓國頂級明星「壬洗拉」，全盛時期突然遭遇事故後失憶，在事業中斷25年後，她為了找回失去的記憶和自己閃耀的位置，與交警「獨孤哲」相遇後發生的浪漫喜劇故事.

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 劇情講述沒有不足和野心、過著安逸生活的銀行合約工，在工作中貪污了VIP顧客的錢之後，讓她平凡的生活產生不可挽回的錯位.

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.

programme.title: 初次，為了愛
programme.desc: 43歲的單親媽媽帶著23歲頂尖醫科生女兒搬到了鄉下小鎮，生活由此發生了翻天覆地的變化。兩人渴望平靜，卻發現自己被古怪卻又熱心的村民包圍，其中包括喪偶的藥劑師。母女之間的緊張關係也逐漸升溫，迎來人生第二幕.

programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.(n)

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.(n)

programme.title: 初次，為了愛
programme.desc: 43歲的單親媽媽帶著23歲頂尖醫科生女兒搬到了鄉下小鎮，生活由此發生了翻天覆地的變化。兩人渴望平靜，卻發現自己被古怪卻又熱心的村民包圍，其中包括喪偶的藥劑師。母女之間的緊張關係也逐漸升溫，迎來人生第二幕.(n)

programme.title: 金子般我的明星

programme.desc: 講述宋仲基飾演的角色本來是一位童星，長大後變成小說家和花店老闆。當他與娛樂公司經理人（千瑀嬉飾）相遇後，在人生中發生了意想不到的轉變，他們曾在少年時代的困難時期互相慰藉，如今命運將他們再次交織在一起，將埋藏已久的記憶喚醒，迫使他們面對以為已經放下的情感.(n)

programme.title: 花書生熱愛史
programme.desc: 劇情講述打破所有固定觀念的寄宿家庭「二花院客棧」的主人尹端午和懷有祕密的寄宿生花書生三人幫。四位青春演繹的清新無邪的神祕浪漫喜劇史劇.(n)

programme.title: 戀人
programme.desc: 一個驕傲地宣稱生命中沒有愛情、不會結婚的男人， 遇到了一個野心勃勃地宣稱要親手贏得所有男人的女人，閃電般墜入愛河。然而面對疫病，丙子戰爭的朝鮮遭受了清軍馬蹄踐踏的摧殘， 她的命運被激流沖走， 他的命運也隨著她的流淌而失控地跌跌撞撞。一個對世界上一切都充滿信心卻 不知愛情會如何改變他的愚蠢男人， 一個 俘虜了世界上所有男人的心卻不知道自己真正愛慕是誰的愚蠢女人。這對對愛情無限愚蠢的男女， 真的能成就愛情嗎？ 不，能活下來嗎？​.(n)

programme.title: 拜託老鷹5兄弟!
programme.desc: 劇集講述傳承三代、釀造傳統酒的釀酒廠「老鷹酒都家」中，個性十足的五兄弟，和才結婚十天就成為寡婦兼一家之主的大嫂之間，有著他們獨特配方的家庭故事 。​.(n)

programme.title: 孝心的家各自為生
programme.desc: 李孝心是為家人打工謀生的體力勞動者，搬家工人。故事講述她試圖擺脫家庭的束縛，尋找獨立和幸福.(n)

programme.title: 初次，為了愛
programme.desc: 43歲的單親媽媽帶著23歲頂尖醫科生女兒搬到了鄉下小鎮，生活由此發生了翻天覆地的變化。兩人渴望平靜，卻發現自己被古怪卻又熱心的村民包圍，其中包括喪偶的藥劑師。母女之間的緊張關係也逐漸升溫，迎來人生第二幕.(n)

programme.title: 私人銀行家
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突.(n)

programme.title: 幸福的婚姻
programme.desc: 幸太郎命中註定的戀人－一位私立高中的美術教師涅盧拉曾在研究所學習修復學，畢業後前往意大利留學。回國後，她持續從事繪畫修復等相關工作，但因某個事件轉行成為美術教師。她平常不輕易流露情感，幾乎不展現笑容，卻擁有足以徹底改變幸太郎（阿部貞夫）婚姻觀念的神秘魅力。\\r\\n描述貫徹獨身主義50年的精英律師原田幸太郎，生活一直理性而有序，直到與涅盧拉命運般的邂逅後閃婚。婚後他逐漸發現，妻子隱藏著一個巨大的秘密，使得他原本平穩的生活走向意想不到的方向.(n)

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.(n)

programme.desc: 幸太郎命中註定的戀人－一位私立高中的美術教師涅盧拉曾在研究所學習修復學，畢業後前往意大利留學。回國後，她持續從事繪畫修復等相關工作，但因某個事件轉行成為美術教師。她平常不輕易流露情感，幾乎不展現笑容，卻擁有足以徹底改變幸太郎（阿部貞夫）婚姻觀念的神秘魅力。\\r\\n描述貫徹獨身主義50年的精英律師原田幸太郎，生活一直理性而有序，直到與涅盧拉命運般的邂逅後閃婚。婚後他逐漸發現，妻子隱藏著一個巨大的秘密，使得他原本平穩的生活走向意想不到的方向.(n)

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.(n)

programme.title: 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….(n)

programme.title: BLUE MOMENT
programme.desc: 晴原柑九朗作為SDM本部首席代表兼氣象研究員利用智慧與知識，冒著生命危險站在最前線，保護人們的性命免受巨大氣象災害威脅，為使命奮鬥的故事。​.(n)

programme.title: 仿生人間
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫.....

programme.title: 四樓的天堂
programme.desc: 巷弄裡的舊公寓四樓，一處名為「天堂」的私人推拿會所。推拿師天意總能以獨特的方式，碰觸客人不願面對的心理傷口，解開層層病因，緩解傷痛。無論是有著黑洞般過往的塗鴉客；害怕失去而習於壓抑情緒的劇場演員；又或是在工作上幫助別人，卻不知如何化解自己母親心結的諮商心理師⋯⋯每個人來到天堂，都能藉由天意的雙手，重新找回心底最柔軟溫暖的自己.

programme.title: 念無雙
programme.desc: 故事改編自十四郎的小說《天下無雙》，講述了為取回神界的寶物，神女無雙下凡刺殺有狐族大祭司源仲，但無雙發現事情另有隱情，在調查的過程中兩人相愛，並攜手拯救了世界的故事.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 原來我很愛你
programme.desc: 《原來我很愛你》該劇改編自木浮生同名小説，講述了桑無焉與偶像詞曲創作者蘇念衾兜兜轉轉的愛情故事.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 月光變奏曲
programme.desc: 《月光變奏曲》改編自晉江文學城作者青浼的同名小説，講述了元氣滿滿的職場菜鳥小編輯初禮遇到「兩副面孔」的傲嬌大神作家晝川后，觸發一場有懟有甜的戀愛成長的故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(n)

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.(n)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.(n)

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(n)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.(n)

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.(n)

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.(n)

programme.title: 四樓的天堂
programme.desc: 巷弄裡的舊公寓四樓，一處名為「天堂」的私人推拿會所。推拿師天意總能以獨特的方式，碰觸客人不願面對的心理傷口，解開層層病因，緩解傷痛。無論是有著黑洞般過往的塗鴉客；害怕失去而習於壓抑情緒的劇場演員；又或是在工作上幫助別人，卻不知如何化解自己母親心結的諮商心理師⋯⋯每個人來到天堂，都能藉由天意的雙手，重新找回心底最柔軟溫暖的自己.(n)

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.(n)

programme.title: 夏花
programme.desc: 本劇以患病少女何冉在生命最後階段學習生活、情感經歷與個人成長為線，講述她在遇到有著難以釋懷過往、幾乎對未來人生失去信心的傑出園藝家蕭寒後，兩人經過一系列誤打誤撞的、溫馨浪漫的奇妙際遇後，從彼此身上尋回各自生命中最重要卻曾經缺失的部分，重拾對生活的信心和希望，也收穫刻骨銘心愛情的故事.(n)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.title: 看看你有多愛我
programme.desc: 單親媽媽怡安獨自撫養雙胞胎女兒長大，姐姐凱希甜美討喜，五歲時意外與怡安成為知名的親子網紅；妹妹莉莉害羞內向，從未在鏡頭前露面，成為無人知曉的另一名女兒。長達十年的網紅人生改變了親子關係，連怡安也難以確認母愛的重量。進入青春期的凱希不想再配合經營粉絲團，聲勢下滑的媽媽決定設計一場凱希失蹤案以引起話題，凱希和莉莉各有所思，同意配合媽媽最後一次。不料眾人以為的假失蹤釀成真綁架，這起綁架事件揭露怡安不為人知的黑暗過往，以及長年深埋的心結.(n)

programme.title: 愛很美味
programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.(n)

programme.title: 今夜一起為愛鼓掌
programme.desc: 佳晨（楊謹華 飾）是一名很會做愛的性治療師，但仍不知道怎麼愛人。圖書館員青語（Ella陳嘉樺 飾）有著外人羨慕的婚姻和工作，卻無法跟老公阿哲做愛。一個不能做愛的女人、和一個很會做愛的女人，當她們逐漸勇於面對自我，揭開過往傷疤；在探索性的旅程中，找到愛的救贖.(n)

programme.title: 看看你有多愛我
programme.desc: 單親媽媽怡安獨自撫養雙胞胎女兒長大，姐姐凱希甜美討喜，五歲時意外與怡安成為知名的親子網紅；妹妹莉莉害羞內向，從未在鏡頭前露面，成為無人知曉的另一名女兒。長達十年的網紅人生改變了親子關係，連怡安也難以確認母愛的重量。進入青春期的凱希不想再配合經營粉絲團，聲勢下滑的媽媽決定設計一場凱希失蹤案以引起話題，凱希和莉莉各有所思，同意配合媽媽最後一次。不料眾人以為的假失蹤釀成真綁架，這起綁架事件揭露怡安不為人知的黑暗過往，以及長年深埋的心結.(n)

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.(n)

programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.(n)

programme.title: 仿生人間
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫.....(n)

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.(n)

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 火星情報局 第7季
programme.desc: 腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: 傳承人 第三季
programme.desc: 非物質文化遺產即某地區文化傳承有重要意義的行為或表現，如民俗、文化、信仰、傳統等各種智慧財產；為了全面展示保護的成果，推動高品質發展，節目打造以非物質文化遺產傳承為主題，令更多人認識及發揚光大.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 你能接受另一半是好友的前任嗎
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 白敬亭王安宇猜詞默契爆棚
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.

programme.title: 新相親大會 第3季
programme.sub-title: 白衣天使聽心跳選男友
programme.desc: 第三季重歸熒屏，新規則持續升級!「選擇心動」改為「親家宣言」，直接展現家風面貌；「權利反轉」由兩盞燈改為三盞燈，增加了嘉賓們的選擇權；新增「親家甄選」環節，刺激代際交鋒.

programme.title: 金曲撈之挑戰主打歌 第2季
programme.desc: 每集由一位原唱歌手對抗三位金曲守護人，以自己的非主打歌與主打歌同台PK，通過現場500位大眾聽審的投票決定挑戰是否成功。原唱歌手包括任賢齊、鄭少秋、吳克群、周筆暢、鄧紫棋、李克勤、趙傳、蔡健雅、許美靜、許茹芸等.

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第2季
programme.sub-title: 終極約會 男女牽手曖昧對視
programme.desc: 延續了上一季的基本模式，尋找一群30+都市輕熟齡男女入住 “半熟公寓”，在經歷一個月的單身公寓合租生活後，他們互相了解，走進了彼此的朋友圈、工作圈、生活圈，呈現不同的社交關係與情感發展，與陳妍希、杜海濤、喬欣、吳昕、王子文等「半熟觀察員」一起見證愛情的發生.

programme.title: 姐姐當家
programme.sub-title: 謝娜母女唱雙簧哄爸爸
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣.

programme.title: 荔枝遊天下
programme.desc: 融合國內外優質旅遊資源，以多元視角帶領觀眾領略世界之美，為你提供不一樣的特色文化旅遊產品.

programme.title: 17號音樂倉庫 第二季
programme.sub-title: 愛是什麼 由你定義
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季
programme.sub-title: 騰格爾吳莫愁唱父親瞬間破防
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 婢女
programme.desc: 講述國公府庶女沈玉清因生母被害，被迫替嫡姐與攝政王裴寂成婚。她化名媚香樓伎女夕顏接近裴寂，暗中揭露國公府與太后勾結的陰謀，同時保護自己的孩子裴昭。二人在對抗敵對勢力過程中歷經生死，最終裴寂假死脫身，與隱居民間的夕顏母子團聚.

programme.title: 百姓的味道
programme.sub-title: 楊千嬅回故鄉尋味亦尋根
programme.desc: 美食紀錄類真人秀，由謝霆鋒擔任「美食尋味官」，與嘉賓一起探尋、領略各地風土人情、壯麗山河，品嘗民間百味；在野趣橫生的自然和充滿煙火氣的城市中，尋覓中國百姓生活，解讀百味人生.

programme.title: 非來不可 第3季
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: 了不起! 舞社 第二季

programme.title: 點贊！達人秀
programme.desc: 全民才藝真人秀節目，圍繞主題聚焦不同類型達人進行同主題表演；邀請了謝霆鋒、鄧紫棋、孟非、伊能靜組成「觀察團」，從各自的專業知識與觀察視角出發，深入百姓生活，挖掘值得點贊的才藝與故事.

programme.title: 主廚的榮耀：中餐季
programme.desc: 聚焦18名來自全國一線「主廚」通過不同對戰形式挑戰各類美食命題，加深著觀眾對廚師技能、主廚職業、飲食文化的多重認知。邀請到四位餐飲界頂級大師董振祥、周曉燕、譚綺文、劉一帆，以及代表食客和經營餐飲店的演員袁弘組成評委團，從不同的角度對主廚創作進行品評，見證主廚形象的誕生.

programme.title: 我是隱藏款

programme.title: 非誠勿擾

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 深夜走心徹聊 深情演繹偶像劇
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.(n)

programme.title: 姐姐當家
programme.sub-title: 謝娜母女唱雙簧哄爸爸
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣.(n)

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴.(n)

programme.title: 我是隱藏款
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到.(n)

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.(n)

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.(n)

programme.title: 傳承人 第三季
programme.desc: 非物質文化遺產即某地區文化傳承有重要意義的行為或表現，如民俗、文化、信仰、傳統等各種智慧財產；為了全面展示保護的成果，推動高品質發展，節目打造以非物質文化遺產傳承為主題，令更多人認識及發揚光大.(n)

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.(n)

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 自己足夠完美才值得被愛
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.(n)

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.(n)

programme.title: 戀戀不忘的我們
programme.desc: 10位渴望愛情的單身男女共同入住「戀戀小屋」，他們中某些人將與意難平的前任重逢，重新審視自己的感情需求，探索與前任復合或開啟新戀情的可能性，在愛與成長、遺憾與釋懷的交織中，尋找理想愛情歸宿.(n)

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 港版大將軍陳偉霆斗翻王安宇
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.(n)

programme.desc: Siu Wai is widowed when her husband was killed in accident. She becomes a mini-bus driver for her living and gradually finds comfort in Dai Fai. As Dai Fai falls for Siu Wai..

programme.title: 兒蹤
programme.desc: April is a beloved 8-year-old daughter of Pij and Ake. Unfortunately, she is kidnapped mysteriously and Pij dedicates her life to finding her missing daughter. One day there is a burnt corpse of a girl and the only thing left is a small piece of fabric that matches April's cloth on the day she disappeared. The DNA result from the fabric proves that it matches 95% of April's DNA. Pij doesn't believe that it is April's corpse and continues searching for her daughter. Pij hires Tan, who used to work for a Missing Children Foundation. Pij has hope again until they meet a psycho man who brutally kidnaps children. The life-threatening struggle to find the truth; therefore, begins..

programme.title: 闔家辣
programme.desc: The COVID-19 pandemic offered white-collar workers everywhere the chance to work from home. At first, it seemed like a luxury to be able to work outside the shackles of the office, but people quickly realized that it could also drive them insane. For Coba, work-from-home has led to a daily cage match with his family. When he inadvertently learns that his mother's homemade chili sauce is a hit with his co-workers, he convinces his family to turn the chili sauce into an online business in order to divert their attention away from conflicts. However, Coba didn't expect that the sauce would become a timely internet sensation, thanks to families eating at home more often during the pandemic.

programme.title: 24小時救參行動
programme.desc: A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. The Korean government dispatches Jae-ho, known as one of Korea's most skilled diplomats, in order to handle the situation. Once he arrives, he asks for the Afghan government's cooperation and uses every means possible to free the hostages. However, his efforts go in vain. Due to his failure, he's forced to work with Dae-sik, a special agent who is an expert on the Middle East. As they begin making their move to get to the Taliban, the first hostage death occurs. With nowhere else to turn, the two become unlikely allies in a race against time to save the rest of the hostages.

programme.title: 車手
programme.desc: Sean is an overconfident rookie in Stealth Riders, a secret police unit consisting of the best drivers in the force that targets against underworld racing and fugitives on the run. Jensen is a legendary escape driver for criminals, who had never been caught before his retirement 15 years ago. When Sean chances upon Jensen out of the blue one day, he thinks his day has finally come..

programme.title: 愛情扯大纜
programme.desc: A story of the sad love between a man who dedicates his youth to the nearly 420-year-old tradition of the Sendai Grand Tug-of-War, and a Korean medical resident who works on Koshiki island, and what happens with them and their families.

programme.title: 毛俠
programme.desc: The Paws-Men are Tat Yan, Charlie, Seal, and Keith. When a dog is in need of rescue, the Paws-Men assemble to save the dog immediately like Batman. ”Paws-Men” tells the story of rescuing dogs, in which Paws-Men encounter many difficulties, such as a dog eatery, bullies and a dog abusing granny. Yet Paws-Men witness true friendships between dogs and humans. This film makes us realize: Saving dogs is not hard. People are the real problem.

programme.desc: The investigation of a prostitute homicide brings headstrong, heavy-handed Detective Manfred in an unlikely collaboration with sly, man-of-the-world Inspector Kee from the Narcotics Bureau..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 閨密盜賞團
programme.desc: In 1970s South Korea, women free divers who have harvested shellfish suffer a threat to their livelihoods after a chemical factory opens in their seaside village. Using their specialty in diving and knowledge of the waters, old friends Choon-ja and Jin-sook start to smuggle goods. However, when they find out they are being set up, they plan for the most mind-bending and dangerous job to seek revenge, which could become their biggest break-or the end of it all.

programme.title: 遺愛
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, young mother Elisa was found guilty of manslaughter; twenty years later, her orphaned girl, Daisy, was arrested for drug possession. Tragedy remains trapped in a fateful loop cursing generations to generations of youth..

programme.title: 屍殺列車
programme.desc: A mysterious viral outbreak pushes Korea into a state of emergency! As an unidentified virus sweeps the country, Korean government declares martial law. Those on an express train to Busan, a city that has successfully fended off the viral outbreak, must fight for their own survival... 453 km from Seoul to Busan. The struggle to survive by those who have others to protect! Get on board to stay alive.

programme.title: 《一秒鐘》幕後紀錄片
programme.desc: “One Second” is the beautiful, moving and deeply personal homage to the redemptive power of cinema from Director Zhang Yimou. This documentary shows the behind-the-scene all the way from pre-production until the last shooting day of the film.

programme.title: 春心萌動的老屋緣廊
programme.desc: Age is just a number when it comes to being a BL fan! 75-year-old widow Yuki (Nobuko Miyamoto) picks up a boys' love manga one day and it opens her eyes to a new world. At the bookstore, she meets shy 17-year-old schoolgirl Urara (Mana Ashida) who reads BL on the sly. Happily reading and discussing BL together, they forge a congenial bond that heals loneliness and unlocks their inner hopes and fears. Seasoned TV director Shunsuke Kariyama (Love's in Sight) and screenwriter Yoshikazu Okada (The 8-Year Engagement) adapt Kaori Tsurutani's award-winning manga into a heartwarming, female-centric human drama about an unlikely friendship that inspires comfort and change.

programme.title: 屍蹤
programme.desc: Entering the houses with the key entrusted to him by the clients, 'Koo Jung-tae', a real estate agent with a hobby of spying on other people's lives. He becomes intrigued by SNS influencer 'Han Sora'. She posts a photo of a vegan salad while actually eating convenience store sausage, prompting him to begin spying on her closely. ‘Koo Jung-tae', eventually sneaks into ‘Han Sora's house, discovers her lifeless body on the sofa. Soon after, he starts receiving threats from someone who knows he was there. As homicide detective 'Oh Young-joo's investigation closes in on him, ‘Koo Jung-tae' is compelled to search for the real culprit using clues from 'Han Sora's social media and the people around her.

programme.title: 我談的那場戀愛
programme.desc: 'Love, once believed, is real.' Despite being swindled out of a large sum of money, the well-known gynecologist Yu still insisted that she was in love. Yu, who had been widowed for several years, met Joe, who was disguised as a middle-aged French petroleum engineer and widower, on a dating app, not knowing that he was part of an online scam group. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. Two initially unlikable people gradually changed through this online romance that began with deception.

programme.title: 奪命金
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles.

programme.title: 長津湖
programme.desc: The story takes place in winter, 1950. In the freezing cold Changjin Lake region, a bloody battle between the United States and China begins. Faced with the harshest conditions of extreme cold, lack of rations and vast difference in weaponry, the Chinese troops forge ahead, fearless and determined. They successfully blow up the Shuimen Bridge, making the most critical victory in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea.

credits.director: 徐克, 陳凱歌, 林超賢

programme.title: 天下無賊
programme.desc: Bo and Li are perfect crime couple crime, until Li decides to quit. It is at the crossroad in their lives and relationships. When they run into Fu Gen, their fate is altered..

programme.title: 刺心切骨
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.(c)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -踢出逆轉勝
programme.desc: The film “Pass and Goal”, collaborated by Gigi Leung, Peter Chan, Ling Man Lung and Rachel Leung, brings a blend of laughter, passion and inspiration. Gigi has burst out laughing when recalled funny scenes from the film. While Man Lung tells that he seemed like a scolded kid during a scene together with Gigi, Rachel also reveals a stunning reason of taking her role and Peter even names Gigi as a “new comedy star held up by romantic film”.(c)

programme.title: 百變靚靚: 門徒
programme.desc: Nick is undercover in Asia's crime trade as he plays protege to a key player, 'Banker', for 8 years. However, as He is more trusted by Banker, he finds himself gradually corrupted..(c)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(c)

programme.title: 六樓后座
programme.desc: Six twentysomethings from their own worlds converge at a bargain apartment affordable by one but perfect for six. With a goal to reach, a deal they make, and a year to complete, they 'fulfill' them with indulging pleasures and, endless games of truth or dare, and madness nourishing the 6th Floor Rear Flat. Sweet Dreams die well when the 12-month lease ends come an unwelcome reminder, the lost souls wake with frightening awareness to the touchline once they think never impossible. Between being responsible and getting away, is youth still a mighty weapon for failures.

programme.title: 販賣．愛
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before..

programme.title: 網戰特攻隊
programme.desc: Talented yet arrogant city desk journalist Lim Sang-jin investigates corruption within the major corporation Manjun, only to have his report debunked as a hoax, leading to his integrity being questioned. “Your article wasn't false. It was a trick that we orchestrated” Then one day, a suspicious tip is sent to Lim. The mysterious whistleblower introduces himself as a member of the online opinion manipulation team known as Team Alep, which fabricated both truth and lies for the right price...Where does the truth begin and the lie end.

programme.title: 風暴
programme.desc: A hardboiled senior police inspector Lui, hot on the trails of a seasoned criminal Nam and his tight crew, determines to put an end to this madness..

programme.title: 重案行動之連環兇殺
programme.desc: One night in Hong Kong, a clip of self-immolation began to go viral on the Internet. Before she died, the female deceased muttered words like she had hit an evil spirit. Then she picked up a lighter and lit it. Her whole body was on fire, and she screamed in pain. All the environmental evidence points to the teacher assisting others to commit suicide. The only thing is that he refused to admit murder, saying that he lost his memory..

programme.title: 總理之夫
programme.desc: Ornithologist (a scholar of birds) Hiyori Soma is married to Rinko, leader of a minority political party. One morning, his beloved wife poses an enigmatic question. “Hey, Hiyori, would you have a problem if I became Prime Minister?” He asks her to repeat the question, but she shrugs him off. Still confused, he sets off for a ten-day expedition on a remote island with no cell phone connection to observe birds in the wild. In his absence, Rinko changes the future of the nation! She is elected the first female Prime Minister in Japan's history, making Hiyori the first ever Prime Minister's husband. He was always 100% supportive of Rinko's political ambitions, but could never have imagined the life that awaited him..

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: The President of Gaming Association blacklisted Wa Sam Group from bidding of gaming concessions on the ground. This blacklisting triggered a series of retaliations from Wa Sam Group. Thus, the Anti-Triad Office immediately set up a special team lead by Lee Shui Ming and he called back Man Fung for help. Fourth Elder's wife Chu Lei received a phone call from her ex-boyfriend Man Fung for a meeting. Kwan Chit, a member of the Gaming Association with the support of Wa Sam Group, also persuaded Man Fung to stop keeping his eyes on them. The two have parted in discord. Kwan Chit remembered the tragic death of his ex-girlfriend Man Kei, sister of Man Fung. He came to Man Fung late at night, the two old friends finally agreed to revenge for their beloved one together.

programme.title: 桃姐
programme.desc: Ms. Zhong Chun-tao had served the Leung's family as a domestic helper since the age of 13. Time went fast and the past sixty years flew by. During this time, some members of the Leung's family had passed away, whilst the rest had emigrated and left the country for good. For the past decade, sister Tao and the only successor of the family, Roger, were the sole remaining members. The master-servant relationship between the two was well and supportive through mutual understanding, but lack of proper communication. One day thereafter, sister Tao was found suffering from..

programme.title: 北京遇上西雅圖
programme.desc: Jiajia goes to Seattle to give birth to the son who's going to help her win over her rich, married boyfriend. But when the city nothing goes right..

programme.title: 2012我愛HK喜上加囍
programme.desc: The patriarch of the household, Kwok Ching is an experienced weather forecaster, who had been eyeing the post of news anchor for the longest time. But due to the oppression from his rival-turned-boss, Ching never had a promotion in his 20-year tenure. Kwok Mei-mei is the eldest of Ching's 3 children. A successful lawyer who specialized in divorce cases, Mei-mei is married to Yao Ming, a submissive husband who doubles as home-maker. Despite being married for years, the couple is still childless and that strains the already fragile relationship. Kwok Ching-ching, the tomboyish daughter of Ching is the second of his children. She and Lok Yi-ah, her effeminate colleague-turned-boyfriend had been discussing about getting married. Aaron Kwok is the youngest of the trio. The seemingly low-esteemed youth actually had this ambitious wish to win the heart of Vivian, a popular star who is rumored to be with tycoon, Roberto! While the daily squabbles within the family continue, Ching rec.

programme.title: 太太，請小心輕放劇場版
programme.desc: Haruka Ayase plays a newlywed wife who hides her past as a secret agent and beats up one bad guy after another like an action star. The identity of her husband (an agent of the Public Security Bureau) played by Hidetoshi Nishijima is gradually disclosed through a thrilling plot development. This story about a husband and wife who lie to each other but love each other nonetheless garnered attention.

programme.title: 毒。誡
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually.

programme.title: 片場職人 -劉永
programme.desc: Anthony Lau, the popular actor in the 1970s, was actually Bruce Lee's protege and known for their work in acclaimed action films. Despite the popularity and recognition for his roles as emperor in TV drama series, he failed to continue success due to personal life but after half a century at this career he has never forgotten his master's teachings. In this episode, Anthony recounts the precious moments with Bruce and unveils his own acting journey.(c)

programme.title: 百變靚靚: 72家租客
programme.desc: Past and present survival of the common man in the big city - ups and downs, laughters and tears... In 1970s Hong Kong, rapacious landlords try to evict 72 tenants but sworn brothers Ha Kugn and Shek Kin help the group of 72 defeat the landlord and landlady and coincidentally rescue Pinky from a planned forced marriage. When both sworn brothers fall for Pinky and propose to her, she flips a coin 'heads or tails' and Ha wins her hand in marriage. The sworn brothers become sworn enemies and Shek's hatred fuels intense rivalry against Ha in business dealings ranging from the manufacture of plastic flowers to the selling of stinky bean curd. Even after 40 years they continue to clash and in 2010 they are in keen competition selling electronics appliances in Sai Yeung Choi Street, Mongkok, the busiest street in the city and still home to the 72 tenants. In fiercely competitive Sai Yeung Choi Street high rents force businessmen to use every means to survive, with electronics shops.

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(c)

Smash-head is a CID officer. Wracked by insecurity he believes the world will be destroyed by pollution. That's why he's an environmentalist. Carmen is a child psychologist. She specializes in hypnotism, her world is full of grace and vitality. That's why she believes in love. The two meet during a police chase. When Smash-head kills a hostage he mistakes as a kidnapper, he is put under internal investigation. And his superior tries to drag him into a corrupt syndicate. With no way out, he turns to Carmen. Under hypnotism, he remembers his long forgotten past and the image he had of himself as a young and enthusiastic fighter for justice. Holding on to this memory and the love of Carmen, he takes his pistol, number 9413..(n)

programme.title: 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family..(n)

programme.title: EXIT：極限逃生
programme.desc: Yong-nam was one of the best rock climbers in college but hasn't had much luck elsewhere after graduation. He has failed to get a job for many years and has to rely on his parents just to get by. For his mother's 70th birthday, he insisted on having the party at Dream Garden because his old crush, Eui-ju works there. When a disaster strikes, covering an entire district in Seoul with mysterious white gas, he has to use all of his rock climbing skills with the help of Eui-ju to get everyone to safety..(n)

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.(n)

programme.title: 飛砂風中轉
programme.desc: Two reluctant triad candidates Roast Pork & Sparrow are racking their brains to outwit each other so that they can stay out of the race for the “Dragon Head” in the underworld.(n)

programme.title: 異山怪談
programme.desc: Members of 'GO2MOUNTAIN' bike riding club try valleys of Mount CHIAK where unreal too-cleanly-cut mutilation murders happened. Moments of freedom riding the mountain, odd things happen around them. Will they survive through what that haunts.(n)

programme.title: 鬼馬狂想曲
programme.desc: In Hong Kong 1969, private investigation agency boss Man is investigating an extra marital case. With his two employees, the smart looking idiot Kit and the Hong Kong Columbia Radio Night School graduate Pufferfish, he follows the target Lascar Row. The trio stumbles into an antique shop and breaks many antiques in the store. The cheap Man force Kit and Pufferfish to take responsibility. Kit wisely makes Pufferfish take sole responsibility. The dumb Pufferfish helpless buys the pile of shattered antiques with his own money. In the pieces he finds a broken magic lamp..(n)

programme.title: 看我今天怎麼說
programme.desc: Wolf, born into a Deaf family, embraces sign language with confidence despite obstacles in life; Sophie, having a cochlear implant at a young age, continuously strives to be seen as 'normal', despite struggling with oral language. Alan, with a cochlear implant like Sophie, is capable of both oral and sign language; he advocates for diverse modes of communication within the deaf community. Bound by love and friendship, the three embark on a self-discovering journey with their own moments of pain.(n)

programme.title: 秘密之丘
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.(n)

programme.title: 北京遇上西雅圖之不二情書
programme.desc: Jiao Ye moved to Macau with her father when she was 15. She is a sassy casino worker who longs for love, but her life was hard. Daniel, a commitment-averse real estate agent in Los Angeles who specializes in selling properties to wealthy Chinese and father of a teenage son. Love blooms between the two as they start exchanging letters because of a book, they sharing their most personal and intimate self with each other.(n)

programme.title: 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks..(n)

programme.title: 百變靚靚: 我愛HK開心萬歲

At the same time, Long, a swindler who conned money from the neighbours 30 years ago is now a property tycoon. He promises to pay each of the 30 neighbours HK$100 million as compensation as long as a representative of each household returns to the estate on Lunar New Year's Eve. A mad rush ensues as Shun and his family tries to gather the old neighbours to avoiding missing the bonanza.(n)

programme.title: 七月返歸
programme.desc: Heung Wing has been sensitive to paranormal activity and keeps seeing ghosts since he was a kid, which is called having “Yin Yang” eyes. To avoid being excluded by his peer, he was taught to pretend nothing happened, even though he knew their existence. He then left from Hong Kong to Canada because of his miserable childhood. One day, Heung Wing is told that his mother has been in coma by committing suicide, which forces him to return to Hong Kong. When he goes back to the old home, everything looks strange and unfamiliar to him. What's more horrifying is, a series of weird cases happen in the neighbourhood, and ghosts show up in front of him again. The situation is deteriorating beyond his imagination..(n)

programme.title: 焚城

Facing this unprecedented calamity, will Hong Kong wake up to an overnight annihilation.(n)

programme.title: 焚城的誕生
programme.desc: Directed by Anthony Pun, 'Cesium Fallout' is the first Hong Kong's historic first radiation disaster blockbuster that has won 5 nominations at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards. programme.title: 煎釀叁寶

As the search for the letter unfolds, alliances are formed, secrets are revealed, and no one can stop the truth that is destined to leave its mark in history.(n)

programme.desc: Five years ago, a fire took the life of Professor Poon, and the notebook on his research for a cancer cure called “super stem cells” disappeared without a trace. Two beauties, Mandy came from poor family and Pearl came from aristocracy. They became soul mates and swore they were friends forever and would help each other on the way to the Princess Selection. But they discovered that there was only one girl could be the Princess, and things became different. programme.title: 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. programme.desc: A menacing forest of fiber and data lies behind every digital screen. However, not even the strongest of the hackers can do in Chun, a genius cyber security engineer who can fend off any attack with his innovative, self-developed protective firewall system. To fight Chi and regain his integrity and credibility, Chun has to venture into the dark web where he can deploy an all-powerful AI virus that he created; along the way taking down violent hit-men and hackers in order to uncover the evidence of Chi's crimes. In the meantime, Chi attempts to seize Chun's technology, further resorting to.(n)

Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime and establish a new China. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. programme.title: 七劍
programme.desc: In the early 1660's the Manchurians took over the sovereignty of China and established the Qing Dynasty. With many pro-nationalist revolts occurring, the newly set-up government immediately imposed a ban on the study and practice of the Martial Arts. Fire-wind, a military official from the previous dynasty, ravages and ranges across North-western China with his next goal to attack the final frontier - the intransigent and hold-out town know as the Martial Village. Fu Qinghu, a retired executioner from the previous dynasty, feels a moral obligation to try and put a stop to this brutality and decides to save Martial Village. He convinces two young people from the village to travel with him to Mount Heaven in order to seek help from Master Shadow-Glow, a hermit who is a master of swords and leads a group of disciples with unimaginable swordsmanship..(n)

programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.(n)

programme.desc: Rita, 53, and her husband Siu Hung were planning their retirement when they suddenly discovered that they were pregnant! Until at a family dinner, two children accidentally discovered the secret of their mother, and the reaction was uproar. At the same time, Siu Hung's sister-Fuk Ling returned from abroad and decided to move in with everyone. The incompatible relationship between sister-in-law and sister-in-law suddenly plunged the Lee family into a chaotic dispute. In anger, Rita decided to become a senior mother and decided to give birth to the child in her belly. The peaceful and well-off family began an unprecedented 'big reform'. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.(n)

programme.desc: “I'll save you! Over and over! This time, she was killed right in front of his eyes... The key to saving Hinata was linked to a tragic event that had torn apart the six founding members of Tokyo Manji... Six best friends who swore to die for one another. Why did they turn against each other? The epic battle on Halloween, October 31, would pit best friends against each other and threaten to destroy the Tokyo Manji Gang.(n)

programme.desc: A traffic accident changed their lives forever. In capturing wanted criminal Zhang Yidong, Sergeant Tang Fei was involved in a gunfight and car accident that put the criminal in a coma. But in the process he also crippled an fellow officer, and mistakenly shot dead the elder daughter of public prosecutor and single mother Gao Min. Unable to handle the guilt, Tang Fei succumbs to a fog of pain. Gao Min, meanwhile, pours all her love and attention to her younger daughter Ling. Three months later, the criminal Zhang Yidong awakens from his coma. Gao Min, who had been working hard on bringing him to justice, insists he stand trial immediately.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(n)

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.(n)

programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.(n)

programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.(n)

A mysterious A-Class Gourmet group led by Gourmet-Poy has taken over the carnival. Can Shin-chan and the Kasukabe Defense Corps carry out their mission and bring happiness to the ordinary people.(n)

programme.title: 寒戰
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid..(n)

programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.(n)

programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.(n)

But he doesn't expect to see that Chaoyue's life is in shambles as well. They retreat to the memories of their lives, both shared and separate, in an attempt to lift each other up from their current situation.(n)

Businesswoman Elsa discovers that her boyfriend Daniel is cheating on her with Macau's female champion, Surewin. Driven by her competitive spirit, Elsa vows to settle their score in the ring. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. There, she encounters MOK Ka Lei, who had previously clashed with her during an advertisement shoot. To escape his debtors, he flees to Macau and works as a gym assistant. He meets and ends up training Si-Qi, a hot-blooded young man who enrolled in an open MMA competition with no fighting experience. After a series of wins, Si-Qi is critically injured and eliminated from the tournament. Ignited by Si-Qi's persistence and unwillingness to give up in the face of defeat, he rediscovers his will to fight and steps back in the ring against the fighter who injured his student..(n)

Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General..

No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..

In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

However, Cheng was repeatedly able to escape. Train service between Shanghai and Chengdu was launched. The first train carried many high officials and noble lords including a Japanese envoy with the national treasure. It drew the attention of Shanghai triads colluding with gangsters to plunder the treasure. The train was forced to stop at Hanshui town due to the railroad was exploded by Cheng..

programme.title: 錦繡前程

Leslie is a wandering soul who seems unable to settle down. He give got fired and his girlfriend left him. Tony is a frustrating musician and a part-time worker at an elderly home. He doesn't like old people, but works there only to get close to his dream girl WAI.(n)

programme.title: 新英雄本色

The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. Since it was the top secret mission, Lieutenant Lam could only select Chinese felons from the Federal prison lured by the right of residence and big money to execute the mission. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end. However, only few of them were able to come back eventually.(n)

programme.title: 情聖
programme.desc: Shing and Betty want to find money to pay back the loan shark. They break into a house and prepare to steal the valuable items in it. Old Bill, who also owes debts to the loan shark, happens to be in the house. He pretends to be the owner, because he thinks Shing is a wealthy man that he could cheat him for money. Eventually, they find out each other's real identity and cooperate to set plans and trap the loan shark.(n)

programme.title: 黑俠II

Things get worse when Black Mask's arch nemesis, Lang, has plans of his own involving Moloch and his mutants..(n)

programme.desc: Archaeologist Shum finds an antique jade with supernatural power in Greece. The stone is wanted both by KGB's agent Karoff and the Interpol. He discovers the crystal is from space and they become friends. While Nike is imputed and jailed, Karoff comes and captures Pan to get the jade.....(n)

programme.title: 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Disc jockey Piggy Chan, mechanic Sapi and cousin Hayden are good friends. Three of them from a trio - LOVEBURSTERS. Piggy falls in love at first sight with Jane Yu. programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: The Buddhist Monk and the Taoist Priest, both blessed with ghost-taming powers, have been quarrelling all over the landscape. Still, they are good friends. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself..(n)

programme.desc: Yip has had bad luck ever since her teenage days. She decides to seek help from famous Feng Shui expert Lai, who discovers that her bad luck is causd by his rival..(n)

During the end of the film, inmates decide to go on hunger strike to protest against the cigarette price rise, this causes problems with “Assassin”. Ching bit “Scarface”‘s ear off and gets an extended sentence, Yiu is released from the prison.(n)

Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him..(n)

Raymond mistakes for love luck yet he fails to have an affair with Siu Hung before she sneaks away with the jewelry. When he returns home, a diamond ring is found in his luggage and Sylvia takes it as her birthday present. Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. He requests Sylvia to act if they were first met, but it comes an intruder Money who falls in love with Sylvia at first sight..(n)

Ko learns Kit's romance with Kar. He asks See for help. But Kar defeats their every move..(n)

programme.title: 急凍奇俠
programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.(n)

programme.title: 龍兄虎弟

She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..(n)

Zita, as Chicken's girlfriend thought he would reform. However, to her disappointment, Zita discovered Chicken became a procurer in one of her missions. He begins to get back what he loses five years ago. May actually been badly ill before she comes back Hong Kong. Her only wish before die is to bring Sam back to Hung. After May has died, May's father insists to keep Sam by his sides. Hung tries his best to get back Sam. In order to earn more money, he does a very dangerous stunt. At last, he is injured..(n)

programme.desc: Hero goes home with excited but he finds his parent was killed. Gian took a group of foreigners to Hero's parents and forced them to hand over the Red Sword, their family treasure..(n)

programme.desc: “Rogue”, one of the most significant film of Director Stanley Kwan, earned him the Best Director and made the characters “Fleur” and “Chan Chen-Pang” a legend. He reveals the story behind the film's directorial position and the obstacles he encountered along the production, as well as talking about his delicate sense of portraying women's stories.(n)

programme.desc: Billie Yuen and her two friends Liao Yu Ping and Zhao Shu Ling who came from Taiwan, share the same ideal to become famous. The three women met Tony Cheung who is the son of a rice wholesaler at a bar. Tony was madly clung to the indifferent dressing Billie and then they cohabit. The four friends spent a good night at Liao's home, celebrating her birthday. One night, when Liao came home late, Zhao was found being murdered. Liao was filled with great sorrow. The three friends received Sergeant Lan's inquiry individually. Liao felt depressed since her best friend conceals everything. Tony accompanied Liao back home, the sight stroke a chord in her heart and Tony tried hard to comfort her, then they had sex. Liao was pregnant, it shocked Billie, whereas Tony felt difficult to choose. Finally both Liao and Billie left Tony and the three noticed the one they love the most is-themselves.(n)

David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time..(n)

When martial arts master Wong Kay-ying arrives, his martial arts skills lead local lawmen to suspect that he may be the masked outlaw. Wong's son, Wong Fei-hung, is caught in the line of fire as he fights to clear his name. In the end, Wong and the Iron Monkey must join forces to face the real villain of the piece.(n)
