He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..(n)

The story took place in a night club in the sixties. Zhang Jiawing was a cheerful kid. His best friend Gao Zhi was a shoe boy. Gao‘s father disappeared after losing all his money in stock speculation. The two kids became students to the once renowned singer Johnny, whose career was at low ebb. Johnny had great hopes on them. He vowed to make them become the best of the best..(n)

programme.desc: Few years ago, Sergeant Kong in a mission to capture the head of the “East Rail Corporation” met with Yip Fung who killed the head of East Rail instead. Kong shot at Yip but missed and only a finger was left in the scene. Kong suspected that Yip might be a robot and thus kept a close watch on her, but later turned that he fell in love with Yip. One night, Ko Kit accompanied with four assistants launched a campaign to steal the “Crystal” in East Rail Main Building. Ko was successful in breaking through the security system and got the crystal but at the same time Yip also rushed to join in the robbery..(n)

programme.title: 九二黑玫瑰對黑玫瑰
programme.desc: As soon as Tony Leung, starts imitating the stilted dialogue of 60s heartthrob Lui Kei, film lovers know they've entered a circle of movie-in-jokes and self-conscious world.(n)

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.(n)

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.(n)

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..(n)

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..(n)

programme.title: 特務迷城
programme.desc: Buck trails two suspicious men and jumps into action to foil their plans. Soon after he meets Liu, who convince Buck that he may be the long-lost son of a rich korean businessman..(n)

programme.title: 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.(n)

programme.title: 富貴開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Kong is in the grip of emigration fever. Everybody is either going to Canada or has put in the application. The Ling family – dad, mom, Shirley and sis, is no exception. They need money. So they held a sale of all the furniture. Mom is promised a fat sum by the landlady if she can manage to dislodge tenant David, who happens to be Shirley's boyfriend. Leaking gas, however, kills the Lings. Their souls want to go to Canada but are turned back because of insufficient funds..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲：歌影雙棲天后: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..(n)

programme.title: 衛斯理之老貓
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely..(n)

programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough narrates the award-winning Wild City series that explores the wild side of Singapore. Here on the fringes of the city, the jungle harbours some fascinating species, including many that have never been filmed before. The star of the show is the Raffles' banded langur, one of the least-known primates on the planet. Found only in Singapore and Malaysia, there are only a few hundred left and around 60 have made a home in Singapore's rainforests.

programme.title: 野性城市: 森森不息
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough narrates the award-winning Wild City series that explores the wild side of Singapore. Here on the fringes of the city, the jungle harbours some fascinating species, including many that have never been filmed before. The star of the show is the Raffles' banded langur, one of the least-known primates on the planet. Found only in Singapore and Malaysia, there are only a few hundred left and around 60 have made a home in Singapore's rainforests.(n)

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
Should farming be offered as curriculum in Singapore schools? 

As the creation of the metaverse gathers pace, the chasm between the digital and the natural world will only widen. What can growing wild offer?

“A lot of people actually think that you are taking care of the plants but actually, they are taking care of us.” Plant otaku.

Gather your succulents, rally your papayas, and make a date with your favourite gardening hoe. In the final episode of Growing Wild, we get dirty. 

And we are doing it together.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week’s episode Recovery Op Jim is called to the scene of two crashed artics on the M1. Recovery Op Rory attends what looks like a simple job, but some hidden vandalism leaves him scratching his head and needing to improvise. programme.desc: A huge special ship on six legs, wind turbines almost 150 metres high, far out in the North Sea, off the coast of the island of Sylt. Here, one of the largest wind farms in the German North Sea is being built. In record time and at dizzying heights, 80 wind turbines are being erected there on an area of around 70 square kilometres. Thanks to precise planning and with the help of high-tech equipment, it takes just one day to assemble a wind turbine. Working in all weathers, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. In operation, the most modern and largest installation ship in the world.

programme.title: Building Big 第1季
programme.desc: A huge special ship on six legs, wind turbines almost 150 metres high, far out in the North Sea, off the coast of the island of Sylt. Here, one of the largest wind farms in the German North Sea is being built. In record time and at dizzying heights, 80 wind turbines are being erected there on an area of around 70 square kilometres. Thanks to precise planning and with the help of high-tech equipment, it takes just one day to assemble a wind turbine. Working in all weathers, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. In operation, the most modern and largest installation ship in the world.(n)

programme.desc: Mike heads to the Highlands of scotland to spearfish for Pollack crab and scallops to create crab pasties and a sumptuous seafood stew.(n)

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: Eight celebrities embark on a 12-day expedition in the rainforest of Costa Rica, where they must learn to navigate difficult terrain, build shelters, make fire and eat the food that nature provides. From abseiling down ferocious waterfalls to crossing perilous rapids, the stars face a range of tough tasks and Bear himself eliminates one of them after each challenge, leaving three in the final. Kelly Holmes, Mike Tindall, Emilia and Laurence Fox, Max George, Jamelia, Vogue Williams and Tom Rosenthal make up the team.(n)

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: Tensions run high as the celebrities navigate their way through dense jungle down a ravine, and when they eventually reach what will be their camp for the night, a meal of live scorpions is on the menu. The following morning, they bathe in the nearby river - their first wash in three days - but the relief is only short-lived when Bear arrives for the team's first big test - a descent of a 120ft waterfall. At the end of an action-packed day, one more member of the group faces elimination.(n)

programme.title: Wardens 第9季
programme.desc: Michigan Conservation Officers remove a gill net from Lake Michigan that had been lost and was discovered by recreational divers. Also, C.Os in District 7 patrol ORV riders.(n)

programme.desc: Take a walk on the wild side with Zoologist Chris Humfrey as he delves into the fascinating world of Australian wildlife. Learn about each animals classification, adaptations, habitats, ecological niche and fun facts.(n)

programme.title: Building Big 第1季
programme.desc: A new superlative ropeway is being built on Germany's highest peak. It holds three world records: the highest steel construction support. The longest free span and the greatest difference in height in one section. Millimetre work at an altitude of 3000 metres! The new ropeway will cover an altitude difference of 1945 metres. That is unique in the world. Extreme winds, very little space and the abyss lurking all around - the construction is a very delicate job. The weather on the Zugspitze can change abruptly. The construction has to be completed as quickly as possible. A special helicopter flies the individual parts up the mountain. The conditions on the Zugspitze only allow for helicopter assembly. A masterpiece of engineering and a feat of strength by its builders. Nerves of steel are needed here and above all: a head for heights.(n)

programme.desc: Eight celebrities embark on a 12-day expedition in the rainforest of Costa Rica, where they must learn to navigate difficult terrain, build shelters, make fire and eat the food that nature provides. From abseiling down ferocious waterfalls to crossing perilous rapids, the stars face a range of tough tasks and Bear himself eliminates one of them after each challenge, leaving three in the final. programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: Tensions run high as the celebrities navigate their way through dense jungle down a ravine, and when they eventually reach what will be their camp for the night, a meal of live scorpions is on the menu. The following morning, they bathe in the nearby river - their first wash in three days - but the relief is only short-lived when Bear arrives for the team's first big test - a descent of a 120ft waterfall. At the end of an action-packed day, one more member of the group faces elimination.(n)

programme.sub-title: Secrets of the Great White Shark
programme.desc: Feature documentary studying the history of the sharks species, alongside their anatomy and how they’ve helped our oceans for hundreds of millions of years. However, in the modern age they face extinction and demonisation. Over 1000 million sharks are killed every year, and it is up to us to save them.(n)

programme.title: Building Big 第1季
programme.desc: A new superlative ropeway is being built on Germany's highest peak. It holds three world records: the highest steel construction support. The longest free span and the greatest difference in height in one section. Millimetre work at an altitude of 3000 metres! The new ropeway will cover an altitude difference of 1945 metres. That is unique in the world. Extreme winds, very little space and the abyss lurking all around - the construction is a very delicate job. The weather on the Zugspitze can change abruptly. The construction has to be completed as quickly as possible. A special helicopter flies the individual parts up the mountain. The conditions on the Zugspitze only allow for helicopter assembly. A masterpiece of engineering and a feat of strength by its builders. Nerves of steel are needed here and above all: a head for heights.(n)

偵探艾迪森 -無頭獵人之謎
programme.desc: Addison has to solve the mystery of what's making scary sounds after Donnie convinces the other kids on an Ayrton Rangers camping trip that a mythical spook called the Headless Haunter is wandering through the park.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -惡毒的蚊子之謎
programme.desc: When swarms of mosquitoes mysteriously descend on the park, the kids' summer movie night is in danger of being cancelled unless Addison and her friends can figure out a way to stop them.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -地球日
programme.desc: Let's celebrate this wonderful planet we call home! Make sure to remember our 3 Rs.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -麵粉
programme.desc: Ahh something smells so good, what is it? Oh it's Hepi and Briko's fresh new ideas! What are they up to now.

programme.title: 優可 -瓦瓦湖的怪獸
programme.desc: When Mai loses her racquet in the Lake, Ranger Loops tells the legend of the Monster of Lake Wawa, which has a surprising ending.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -美食日
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain is looking for locals to enter a foodie competition. Ricky makes art from food, including a lasagna mosaic and a chocolate portrait in homage to artist Vik Muniz, while Masterchef Gav cooks up some unlikely food combos in the kitchen.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -童話故事日
programme.desc: Ricky makes dragon feet trainers and a beastly collage inspired by Hannah Hoech and finds himself in a fairy tale after being trolled by his virtual assistant. Things get weirder when Gav shows up with three little pigs.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -末日種子庫
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents the best of inventions: wheelchairs for disabled pets, a robot that helps reduce football injuries, wristband lights that can make a concert experience unique and a seed vault ensuring the world's future.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -水中摩托車
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents a jet ski submarine that flies underwater, a soccer ball that creates electricity, an insect catcher and the new generation of vinyl records.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -一切的開端, 上集
programme.desc: A strange mineral from the Big Bang hits the atmosphere and breaks into many shards. When six children find some of the fragments, Margherita Rita is convinced these amazing kids could be the world's chance to take real action against climate change.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -一切的開端, 下集
programme.desc: The children arrive at the Meteo Expert Center. They are excited but also a little unsure of what to expect. Margherita Rita explains to them how the kids can use their superpowers in the fight against climate change and save the environment.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -蠕蟲農夫
programme.desc: Kids meet a worm farmer.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓玩具
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat toy.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去都柏林
programme.desc: When Lorna confesses that she suffers from bad luck, the gang travels to Ireland on St. Patrick's Day, the luckiest day of the year. Their new friend Sean takes them on a tour of the city to see if he can help them find better luck.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -南瓜與巨龍
programme.desc: Rose accidentally turns Regal Academy into a pumpkin patch. The teachers need a rare colossal pumpkin to reverse the spell. With help from Alicia, Puss In Boots' granddaughter, Rose, Hawk, and the others must find the rare pumpkin to save the school.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -豹為何有斑點
programme.desc: Mathematician and cryptographer Alan Turing came up with a chemical theory of morphogenesis to explain why leopards have spots. It's not proven, but recently bio-chemists have discovered chemicals are working as he predicted.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -阿尼斯堡: 小卡魯絕美秘境
programme.desc: The team visits Anysberg, an island mountain in the Karoo Desert. They find a cave with mysterious rock art that provides a glimpse into the past, and they discover how Nature can recover when given a chance.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -甘卡堡: 山峰要塞
programme.desc: The team visits the Gamkaberg Mountains in search of a magnificent creature that escaped extinction in the inaccessible canyons of this fortress. While lost in a cave, they miraculously stumble on the almost-vanished Cape Mountain Zebra.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -幽靈潛水艇
programme.desc: Does a ghost submarine sail out there somewhere in the ocean? Ant believes it does.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -深淵在凝視你
programme.desc: The Nektons are diving in a sinkhole in the middle of the sea when strange things start to happen.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宮廷愛情
programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -煉金術
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of medieval alchemy, introduced by our mad scientist friend, Howler! He's looking for a way to transmute lead into gold: it's the only way to escape insatiable Lord Roach's fort as the greedy noble seeks to increase his fortune.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -智力升級
programme.desc: The principal warns: fail the next exam, and you're out. Everyone worries about Flippy. Carol wants to tutor him, Robbie plans to steal the test, Naomi suggests a nerd disguise, Jessi bakes brain cookies, and Motor builds a genius cap-but smart Flippy isn't so nice.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -娜歐蜜的生日
programme.desc: Naomi's birthday is coming, and she's planned it all-including the pricey gift her friends must buy. To afford it, Albert writes homework, Carol babysits, Flippy dances, and Robbie... borrows from Naomi! But will the gift-and the party-be all she hoped for.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民

programme.desc: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills season 15 kicks off on Monday,Housewives Erika Jayne, Dorit Kemsley, Kyle Richards, Bozoma Saint John, and Sutton Stracke return for a season marked by fresh starts, major fallouts and unforgettable adventures. New housewife and fashion mogul Rachel Zoe makes a dazzling return to Bravo after more than a decade. Single and stepping back into the spotlight on her own terms, she’s ready to unveil RZ 2.0 to the world. programme.title: 證義搜查線之騙局拼圖 (普通話)
programme.desc: 上市医美公司「正在美丽」老板蒋慧敏，以配新股方法筹集资金来购买声称潜力甚高的「安然制药」，但证监会怀疑后者只是业务不明的空壳公司。调查员凯茵独自进行厂房实地查核时遇上小意外受伤，上司Tony却重申不同意她过份拚搏的思维，并揭示自己的调查：蒋慧敏向「安然」负责人麦江出价购买公司是为藉词配股，此前她已操控「人头户口」来推高股价，制造利好假象，惟户口全不在境内，令举证困难。坚执的凯茵咬住不放，在渺茫希望下仍翻查大量资料，终找到破洞，成功证明蒋慧敏直接导致市场失当的行为，令本来趾高气扬的她无话可说！其实Tony与凯茵各因其人生经历而有既成的价值观──凯茵曾有一位挚友被骗财骗色后，一时想不开而寻短，令凯茵对骗徒极度咬牙切齿；而Tony则历过千帆，明悟凡事有因有果，不必过于执着。两人的分歧在调查工作上，渐趋明显，如何能成功磨合.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: Televised dining of the golden age
programme.desc: Hong Kong’s television industry was once thriving, the 1970s and 1980s are fondly remembered as the “TV boom” era, a shared memory among Hong Kong residents. In recent years, however, the rise of streaming platforms and intensified competition from neighboring regions have led to a decline in advertising revenue for commercially operated broadcasters, posing a significant challenge to the local TV sector. How can television professionals stay competitive and collectively promote “Hong Kong productions” into broader markets, restoring the industry’s former glory.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Indians are in fact the fourth largest ethnic minority group in Hong Kong after Filipinos, Indonesians and Whites. India and Hong Kong are connected because both places were ruled by Britain from the mid 19th century. Indians sold fabric and clothes made in Hong Kong to British people. They also set up trading companies and exported goods to other Commonwealth countries, to take a share in the huge trade market. . Bilingual: English / Cantonese (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2024.05.13 MON 10:30pm / RTHK32.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 透過與拿騷年輕創作人的交往，我們看到這個巴哈馬首都的另一面；這些「天堂鳥」把加勒比海島國的娛樂事業，推進到另一個新紀元。原來，在拿騷只要踏出慣常的遊客熱點，就可以看見巴哈馬人比起環島海洋更耀眼的光芒。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月22日 星期二晚，10時30分 Along with the young Creatives of Nassau we get to experience a side of Nassau that has never been seen before. These ‘Birds of Paradise’ push the creative edge of the Caribbean islands to a new era of entertainment. We come to learn that should one step off the tourist grid in Nassau, the Bahamian people are more vibrant than the very oceans that surround these islands. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.22 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 埃克蘇馬群島完全能夠展現出加勒比海天堂這個美譽，區內三百六十五個島嶼，充滿著各式各樣神話傳說，更添加上一份傳奇色彩。我們來到探索水底藍洞，品嚐新鮮海螺沙律、烤石班、烤龍蝦和烤蟹，隨著傳說故事，探索海天一色的夢幻埃克蘇馬。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月22日 星期二晚，11時00分 The islands of Exuma are the picture perfect description of a Caribbean paradise. Stories, myths and legends fuse with everyday life across the 365 islands within the Exumas. We come to learn that the treasure is scattered in the beauty of the Exumas, from the natural Blue Holes, to the fresh conch salad, the roasted Grouper to the Lobster and crabs. We follow the Legends to discover that the land and ocean blend perfectly into the story of the Exumas. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.22 TUE 11:00pm.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 動聽的歌曲是百聽不厭的！《港樂．講樂》嚴選一系列值得回味的作品，讓大家再次可以欣賞歌手們的精彩表演。首先頭打陣的系列，就來一個活力爆燈的「動感快歌」。跳舞快歌講求力量與節奏感的配合，曲風、舞蹈編排都可以帶來不同的視聽享受。你的心水歌曲是否榜上有名？記得留意今集節目！. 主持. 阮頌陽.

programme.sub-title: (A) 精彩雪橇之旅 (B) 雪花精靈

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第八集：于海在酒吧買醉
programme.desc: 藍海沒有受到耀輝投資的青睞，于海在酒吧買醉，糾纏周耀加了微信，周耀就此得知于海就是婉真的老公。李臨喜氣洋洋穿上了久違的西裝，他告訴夢安自己獲得了一份實驗室工作，夢安知道是梅一朵的推薦起了作用.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 每隻鸚鵡都是性格巨星，「望咩呀？望望望！」是非洲灰鸚鵡「芭芭雞」的招牌金句。牠是模仿說話的高手，也是家中的破壞之王。故事始於Yoyo十六歲那年，家中迎來了這位新成員，全家人都很雀躍，唯獨是Yoyo覺得家裡多了一個不速之客。九年的相處，讓Yoyo從最初的畏懼，逐漸被灰鸚鵡的智慧和淘氣融化。牠的日常金句和生活片段，更成為Yoyo設計路上的創作靈感和追夢的動力。. 至於珊珊則喜歡小巧可愛的愛情鳥，牠們溫柔的鳴叫聲，以及宛如水彩畫般層層暈染的羽毛色彩，深深觸動了她。2023年的某一天，珊珊發現其中一對愛情鳥悄然發展成為戀人，開始築巢生蛋。新生命的誕生，為珊珊帶來了難以言喻的感動與喜悅。. 無論鸚鵡的性格如何，Yoyo與珊珊都珍惜與牠們相處的每一個小日子，當中有笑有淚，也滿載無法計量的愛與陪伴.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 深夜潛行
programme.desc: 世界各地的研究人員警告光污染危害著植物、動物和人類健康。昆蟲被光吸引，不再覓食或繁殖，甚至因為耗盡體力而死亡……這輯紀錄片透過衛星影像、高感光攝影機及電腦特效，帶領觀眾進入一場獨一無二的沉浸式黑夜探索之旅.

programme.desc: 許夢心孕酮值過高，情緒不好在家大鬧。夢心得到夢寐以求的公寓，婉真感謝夢心幫自己開張，因為她的啟發，婉真想到了更多能夠賣房的思路。許夢安和李臨商量休年假做手術.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 今集的主題食材外表平平無奇，狀似枯木，卻擁有「神仙之食」的美譽——它就是淮山！大廚 Will 發揮無限創意，炮製出色香味俱全的「淮山茶碗蒸」，令兩位嘉賓吃出驚喜。. 身兼長跑教練與星級媽媽的梁諾妍（Inez）活力充沛，熱愛「朝活」的她有時會睡眠不足，但是原來長期熬夜或睡眠質素欠佳，竟是引發脂肪肝的隱形元兇！今集我們邀請到黃麗虹教授深入探討護肝之道，拆解「168斷食法」配合運動如何有效逆轉脂肪肝，並剖析市面上護肝產品成效。兩位成功女性更大方分享如何平衡事業與家庭，以及堅持運動的心得。此外，「識食專員」走入農莊，親身體驗挖淮山的難度。. 主持：黃婉曼（Icy）、Will Leung. 嘉賓：梁諾妍（ Inez）、黃麗虹醫生（香港中文大學醫學院內科及藥物治療學系教授/. 腸胃肝臟科專科.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 於香港要走搖滾音樂路線從來都不容易，要面對很多的難題才能成就到一首被大家看見的作品。路，從來不易走，今集「激情搖滾」系列的樂隊擁有對搖滾音樂的鍾情，及對自己創作的熱情，努力將自己心中所想分享給大家。. 主持. 阮頌陽.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 淨零排放新時代
programme.desc: 本節目深入探討全球家居供暖如何成為氣候變化的主要原因之一，並聚焦於各種綠色替代方案，思考如何邁向永續生活。. 又實地追訪英國家居安裝電熱泵，以取代天然氣供暖的實況、探討氫能應用的環保效益與可行性；更會帶領觀眾，看看全英格蘭最大的陸上風力發電機，怎樣為非牟利組織帶來營利，改善居民生活；以及走到建造核電站及升級電網的工程最前線，全面呈現實現淨零排放目標的各種方案及挑戰。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年1月20日 星期二 晚上10時. . Home heating is one of the major contributors to climate change worldwide. This program investigates the sustainable solutions that could change that. . From getting an insight into how heat pumps are installed to analyzing the feasibility of hydrogen power. We also visit England’s largest onshore wind turbine to see how green energy is funding community improvements, and report from the cutting edge of nuclear construction and grid modernization to reveal the real challenges of the race to Net Zero. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.01.20 Tue, 10pm.

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 曲阜、泰安
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In response to the phenomenon of "more visitors, less spending," what policies has the government implemented? Last year, the government released the " Development Blueprint for Hong Kong’s Tourism Industry 2.0," which emphasizes attracting high-value overnight tourists, including three key groups: MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conventions, and Exhibitions) travelers, cruise passengers, and Muslim tourists. Are these three groups truly higher spenders? What is the current status of the industry in developing these groups, and what measures are being taken to enhance their value.

programme.title: 走進東盟
programme.sub-title: Hashim Djojohadikusumo, Co-Founder of Gerindra Party of Indonesia
programme.desc: Description: ASEAN (the Association of Southeast Asian Nations) was established in August 1967 in Bangkok, and has come to feature ten (soon to be eleven) member-states in Southeast Asia. The comprehensive rise of ASEAN is one of the most remarkable phenomena that have defined global geopolitics and economics over the past two decades. With over 660 million people and a dynamic, young, and vibrant workforce, Southeast Asia is doubtlessly a region to watch for those who are interested in the rise of Asia and the increasingly multipolar world order. As China’s most international, globally embedded, and cosmopolitan city, Hong Kong has a critical role to play in bridging Northeast and Southeast Asia. Through rigorous, robust conversations with leading thinkers, businessmen, politicians, and academics in the region, this programme seeks to platform, exhibit, and demonstrate the fascinating intricacies and pluralities that comprise ASEAN today. . In this episode, Brian Wong talk to Hashim Djojohadikusumo, Co-Founder of Gerindra Party of Indonesia.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Ta Kwu Ling: The Village School
programme.desc: Nestled in the forests of Ta Kwu Ling, a secluded rural school, Ling Ying Public School, stands as a testament to community spirit. Founded in 1958, it once teetered on the edge of closure due to low enrollment. Through a remarkable turnaround, it embraced “forest campus” and “positive education” models, becoming a cherished village school. With a devoted principal, caring teachers, joyful students, and supportive alumni, the school feels like a family brimming with warmth. This episode explores the challenges and triumphs of rural education, told through the stories of those who keep it alive.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: In recent years, green buildings have become a growing trend in the construction industry. Many people believe that installing solar panels or implementing greening projects automatically makes a building environmentally friendly. But is this really the case?. Buildings account for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total electricity consumption, with residential homes, offices, and shopping malls contributing to nearly 60% of the city’s carbon emissions. Achieving energy savings and emission reductions through buildings is no easy task. On top of that, Hong Kong has over 40,000 existing older buildings. How can these aging structures be retrofitted to improve energy efficiency? What methods can be employed.
